تختفوا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَفُوا (taḵtafū) /tax.ta.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# تُخْتَفَوْا (tuḵtafaw) /tux.ta.faw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
